property.name: Configured Bounded Liveness
property.description: This example contract starts only when a valid address phase is accepted with HTRANS[1] and HREADY HIGH. Completion must occur in one of the following four data-phase cycles; same-edge HREADY belongs to the preceding data owner. Reset cancels the obligation. Four is a teaching/configuration bound, not an AHB protocol maximum.
property.svaString: assert property (@(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn) (HTRANS[1] && HREADY) |-> ##[1:4] HREADY);

annotations.message: The NONSEQ address is accepted here because HREADY is HIGH. This same edge completes the preceding data owner and does not satisfy the new obligation.
The accepted address now owns the data phase. Cycles 3-6 are the configured four-cycle completion window.
